run_maskcut_cli: run the MaskCut CLI script to generate pseudo-masks for images in a dataset directory and save COCO-style annotations
run_maskcut_single_image: run MaskCut on a single image using the --img-path flag to visualize pseudo-masks with a DINO ViT backbone
call_maskcut_forward: call maskcut_forward to compute N pseudo-masks from ViT patch features using normalized cut and spectral graph partitioning
call_maskcut: call maskcut to extract bipartitions and eigenvectors from an image path using a DINO backbone and configurable patch size
call_get_affinity_matrix: call get_affinity_matrix to compute a binary affinity matrix from patch features using cosine similarity and a threshold
